name: Two-pass Adaptive Screen Sampling with Interval Partitioning
aliases: Two-pass Adaptive Undersampling with Interval Partitioning
Two-pass adaptive screen sampling plus partitioning the interval of integration into M pieces
Two-pass adaptive screen sampling with interval partitioning
definition: An algorithm that increases adaptive undersampling by partitioning the ray integration interval into M pieces and using a second pass to interpolate or recompute integrals for pixels based on neighborhood coherence.
